schemes.name: Tesco Clubcard
schemes.cost_to_join: Free (optional paid Clubcard Plus reported at GBP 7.99/month)
schemes.discount_mechanism: Clubcard Prices (member-only shelf prices on selected lines, scan card/app or link online account); ~1 point per GBP 1 converts to vouchers at 1p/point
schemes.notes: Tesco.com returned 403; secondary sources only, some dated. Voucher timing/min rules disagree between sources.

schemes.name: My Waitrose
schemes.discount_mechanism: Personalised vouchers/offers and perks; 'Little Treats' monthly rewards unlocked at GBP 50/100/250 monthly spend
schemes.key_perks: Free hot drink, Little Treats, personalised vouchers, 20% off selected service-counter items on set days, partner offers (Uber Eats), free Waitrose Food magazine; ~10 member benefits
schemes.notes: Name now styled 'My Waitrose' (was MyWaitrose) per 2026 articles; a larger relaunch was described as upcoming and could not be confirmed. Free-coffee rules reported inconsistently.

schemes.name: Sainsbury's Nectar
schemes.discount_mechanism: Nectar Prices (member-only prices on selected items, swipe/scan or link to online account; not at Locals/petrol); ~1 point per GBP 1, points worth 0.5p+
schemes.key_perks: Nectar Prices, points spendable at Sainsbury's and ~300 partners
schemes.notes: nectar.com page had no detail; sources 2020-2023.

schemes.name: Lidl Plus
schemes.cost_to_join: Free (page does not state; widely free)
schemes.discount_mechanism: Weekly app-only member offers and personalised coupons; points per shop redeemable in Rewards Marketplace; Lidl Pay applies at checkout
schemes.key_perks: App-only offers/coupons, points marketplace, digital receipts, partner offers (18+)
schemes.app_vs_card: App only (as far as page shows)

schemes.name: Co-op Membership
schemes.cost_to_join: GBP 1 (refunded on first in-store shop after selecting a personalised offer)
schemes.discount_mechanism: Member prices on everyday items plus personalised offers selected weekly; scan card/app
schemes.key_perks: Member prices, local-cause funding, monthly GBP 50 draws, Funeralcare/Insurance/Legal discounts, AGM vote, Co-op Live presale
schemes.app_vs_card: Digital card in Co-op app; plastic card optional
schemes.notes: Member prices not at independent societies or franchise stores.

schemes.name: Morrisons More
schemes.discount_mechanism: Member prices on selected items (scan card/app, link online, Deliveroo); points on selected products converted to vouchers (e.g. 5,000 points to a GBP 5 'Fiver' per Which?)
schemes.key_perks: Member prices, points, bonus scan rewards
schemes.notes: morrisons.com page 404. One source says More is now 'My Morrisons'; conflicting. Points conversion rates conflict.

schemes.name: Asda Rewards
schemes.discount_mechanism: Earn 'Asda Pounds' into a cashpot via Star Products (~10% cashback) and missions; convert to vouchers in app; cashpot expires after 6 months unmoved
schemes.notes: asda.com 403; sources 2022-2023 so terms may have changed.

schemes.name: M&S Sparks
schemes.cost_to_join: Free (Sparks Plus paid trial, GBP 120/yr, invite-only)
schemes.discount_mechanism: Sparks Prices member pricing on selected items (trialled in ~50 stores; national status unconfirmed); weekly free-shop draw
schemes.student_perk: Possible student freebie (Percy Pigs) seen in Save the Student result, unverified

schemes.name: Iceland Bonus Card
schemes.discount_mechanism: Savings-style: top up card, get GBP 1 bonus per GBP 20 loaded (~5%); spend balance in store/online
schemes.key_perks: Top-up bonus, periodic promos, app offers
schemes.notes: Brief suggested a 25% bonus; sources show ~5% top-up bonus (25% was a Bonus Card branding of older/promo offers, not confirmed).

schemes.name: Aldi UK
schemes.discount_mechanism: No loyalty scheme; everyday low prices, no card or app required
schemes.notes: Sept 2026 report: Aldi remains the only major UK supermarket without a scheme.
